articles.summary: Introduces Third Quarter Outlook with Continued Improvement in Sequential Sales Trend IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 3, 2025-- Tilly’s, Inc. (NYSE: TLYS, the "Company") today announced financial results for the second quarter of fiscal 2025 ended August 2, 2025 .
articles.title: Tilly's, Inc. Reports Fiscal 2025 Second Quarter Operating Results
